bargaining_calibration.note: response_cost had zero measurable effect in [0.02, 0.2] (resources are already too deeply negative post-collapse for the ask size to matter); activation is driven by the interaction of contribution_period_steps and sequencing_min_duration_steps, not by response cost -- a disclosed null result on one of Section 7's licensed levers, not hidden.

decision_gate_note: "do not prefer F" (the number three) governs the DISCOVERY PIPELINE'S OWN DEFAULT, exactly as Level 1.3's own DECISION_GATE_NOTE governed E there -- no Stage 3-10 script may special-case or bias toward three discrete families; every outcome, F included, remains legitimate if the data support it. Family-to-dissertation-trajectory mapping is explicitly deferred until AFTER blind discovery (Stage 4), fresh confirmation (Stage 8), and the S_obs-Z_obs audit (Stage 9) are all frozen, per this milestone's own Section 19 requirement.

decision_gate_outcomes.A_no_effect: no reproducible historical/sequencing effect detected at all
decision_gate_outcomes.B_pressure_responsive_nonhistorical: institutions respond to pressure MAGNITUDE but not to its temporal ORDER or history -- current-state-dependent, not path-dependent
decision_gate_outcomes.C_transient: differentiation appears but does not persist -- families/gradient reconverge given enough steps (Stage 5's own diagnostic)
decision_gate_outcomes.D_persistent_continuum: persistent path dependence on a CONTINUOUS gradient, not separable discrete families
decision_gate_outcomes.E_two_families: persistent path dependence into exactly two reproducible discrete families
decision_gate_outcomes.F_three_families: persistent path dependence into exactly three reproducible discrete families
decision_gate_outcomes.G_four_or_more_families: persistent path dependence into four or more reproducible discrete families
decision_gate_outcomes.H_inconclusive: evidence does not clearly support any of A-G (e.g. contradictory stage results, failed frozen-compatibility, disqualifying generalization gap with no clear discrete-vs-continuum resolution)

firewall: no SEM/dissertation data, labels, trajectory names, or country names read anywhere in Stage 0/3-10 (Section 3)

frozen_references.corrected_level13: SimulationConfig.level12b_frozen_reference() + Level 1.3's own corrected (post-task-#109-fix) transmission wiring, historical_module_enabled=True
frozen_references.level12b_historical_off: SimulationConfig.level12b_frozen_reference() with every Level 1.3 historical_module_enabled=False (byte-identical to Level 1.2b)

hypotheses.H1_bargaining_activation: bargaining_participation activates (a sustained crossing is registered) in a nondegenerate share of eligible runs once the Work Package B construction fix is applied, without further generative calibration
hypotheses.H2_ordering_effect: the temporal ORDER in which pressure channels activate produces measurable, reproducible variation in institutional response (S_obs, Z_obs, and/or the sequencing vector), holding total pressure exposure matched
hypotheses.H3_temporal_persistence: differentiation observed mid-run persists (does not fully reconverge) through the final-sustained window, distinguishing genuine path dependence from transient response
hypotheses.H4_entrenchment_moderation: entrenchment strength (off/moderate/strong) moderates how much differentiation persists once established -- stronger entrenchment predicts less late-run reconvergence
hypotheses.H5_history_matters_causally: erasing or reversing pressure history (Stage 6, matched interventions, sham-controlled) produces trajectory divergence beyond what the sham (identical-state-copy) intervention alone produces
hypotheses.H6_legitimacy_channel_effect: performance and/or procedural legitimacy channels measurably affect S_obs/Z_obs and/or persistence, independent of entrenchment
hypotheses.H7_fresh_replication: whatever structure (discrete, continuous, or path-dependent) Stage 4's discovery finds, generalizes to Stage 8's disjoint fresh confirmation at better than Level 1.3's own -1.29-vs--6.05 generalization gap
hypotheses.H8_discreteness: the discovered structure is genuinely discrete (beats every continuous alternative on fresh data per Stage 7's rule) -- explicitly allowed to fail even if H1-H7 all hold, since Level 1.3's own evidence already leans continuum

rng_commitments.note: mandatory for every Stage 0/3-10 run this milestone; every new stochastic operation gets its own registered deterministic substream

stage3_matched_factorial.matched_cumulative_pressure_exposure: every cell shares the SAME total pressure-onset budget (onsets in {0,150,300} used exactly once each across the three channels for security_first/bargaining_first; coevolution uses onset 0 for all three, by construction an equal, not merely float-tolerant-equal, exposure case) -- required contrasts computed only WITHIN matched entrenchment/legitimacy/stratum cells across the three orderings, never pooled across cells that differ on those factors
stage3_matched_factorial.uncertainty_method: seed-clustered bootstrap CIs (resample whole seeds, not individual runs, within each matched cell) -- raw matched differences reported alongside, never pooled means alone

stage4_homogeneous_discovery.scale_disclosed_as: Section 8's own stated MINIMUM (48 points x 5 seeds = 240 runs), not the preferred 72-96 x 6-8 -- disclosed here, before running, per this milestone's own session-budget-scaling discipline

stage5_temporal_persistence.rule: never classify from final-step values alone -- every category above requires the windowed trajectory, not a single snapshot

stage6_history_erasure.sham_purpose: prove the serialization/copy machinery itself is a byte-identical no-op before trusting any of the other five interventions' divergence as historically meaningful

stage7_model_comparison.rule: no k chosen from silhouette alone; no preferred k; a discrete result must beat every continuous alternative on FRESH (Stage 8) data to count as discrete

stage8_fresh_confirmation.scale_disclosed_as: Section 13's own stated MINIMUM (24 x 4 = 96), not the preferred 36-48 x 4-6

stage9_measurement_audit.rule: do not redefine S_obs/Z_obs to manufacture independence; if measurement-induced, correct transparently, version it, preserve both the original and corrected variant
